deviation: Payment is 30 days from receipt of a valid invoice instead of the standard 45. That matches the playbook fallback, so it is acceptable, but it shortens Arcadia's payment window. The draft also omits the 1% per month cap on late interest. It requires annual invoices without saying whether they are in arrears. If they are issued in advance, that would breach the playbook's one-quarter limit on advance payment.
suggested_text: The Customer shall pay undisputed invoices within 45 days of receipt of a valid invoice. Late payment interest shall not exceed 1% per month. No fees shall be invoiced or payable more than one quarter in advance of the period to which they relate.
